content.short: What began as a 2021 Ethereum NFT collection, Pudgy Penguins is now a brand with toys, mobile games and the PENGU token.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins began as 8,888 penguin NFTs on Ethereum and has turned into one of the most recognisable brands in crypto. Next to the original collection and Lil Pudgys, the brand sells Pudgy toys in big retail chains and runs mobile games like Pudgy Party and Pengu Clash. Its PENGU token lives on Solana. Collectors can trade directly through the Pudgy Penguins marketplace. The brand's licensed toys are sold under the Igloo name, and the marketplace lists Pudgy Penguins, Lil Pudgys and other collections side by side.
